fullPassage: Dictionary definitions are constantly revised to keep up with our changing uses and knowledge. In Roman times, "addicts" were people who were unable to pay their debts and gave themselves as slaves to their creditors. The word eventually came to be associated with drug dependency: one becomes a slave to one's addiction. The word "husband" originally referred to being a homeowner; it had nothing to do with being married. But because owning your own property made it more likely you'd find a mate, the word eventually came to mean a male who has been wed. On November 5th, 1605, Guy Fawkes tried to blow up the British Parliament. He was captured and put to death. Loyalists burned his effigy, which they nicknamed the "guy." Centuries later, the word lost its negative connotation and a musical named Guys and Dolls ran on Broadway. In American slang, bad means good, cool means great, and wicked means excellent. If you could transport yourself one hundred years into the future, you'd find yourself confused by your great-grandchildren's speech because language itself is an ever-changing reflection of human invention.

questions.passage: Dictionary definitions are constantly revised to keep up with our changing uses and knowledge. In Roman times, "addicts" were people who were unable to pay their debts and gave themselves as slaves to their creditors. The word eventually came to be associated with drug dependency: one becomes a slave to one's addiction. The word "husband" originally referred to being a homeowner; it had nothing to do with being married. But because owning your own property made it more likely you'd find a mate, the word eventually came to mean a male who has been wed. On November 5th, 1605, Guy Fawkes tried to blow up the British Parliament. He was captured and put to death. Loyalists burned his effigy, which they nicknamed the "guy." Centuries later, the word lost its negative connotation and a musical named Guys and Dolls ran on Broadway. In American slang, bad means good, cool means great, and wicked means excellent. → 완성: he was captured and put to death
det.tip: was captured and (was) put to death : 두 번째 was는 생략, 과거분사만 병렬.

det.korean: 밑줄 친 부분(burning → burned)을 문장의 정동사 형태로 고치는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 부분은 'Loyalists __________ his effigy(왕당파가 그의 인형을 태웠다)' 자리예요.

→ 이 문장에는 주어 Loyalists에 대응하는 '진짜 동사(정동사)'가 필요해요. 앞뒤가 과거 시제로 이어지므로 과거형 burned가 와야 문장이 완성돼요.

→ 현재분사 burning은 동사가 아니라 '~하면서'라는 분사라, 그대로 두면 주어만 있고 동사가 없는 불완전한 문장이 되어 틀려요. burning을 burned로 고쳐 써요.
det.tip: 주어 뒤에는 -ing(분사)이 아니라 정동사(과거형 burned)가 필요.

[조건] (1) could, future, hundred, if, into, one, the, transport, years, you, yourself 를 모두 사용 (2) 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~할 수 있다면'을 가정법 과거로, '자신을'을 재귀대명사로 영작하는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
'만약 ~라면'이라는 가정이라 If로 시작해요.

→ '보낼 수 있다면'은 현재 사실과 다른 상상이라 가정법 과거예요. 조동사 could 뒤에 동사원형 transport를 써서 could transport로 표현해요.

→ '자신을'은 주어(you)와 같은 대상이라 재귀대명사 yourself로 써요.

→ '백 년 뒤 미래로'는 one hundred years into the future로 붙여요.

→ 완성: if you could transport yourself one hundred years into the future
det.tip: If + 주어 + could + 동사원형 = 가정법 과거 (~할 수 있다면) / 주어=목적어 → yourself.

[조건] (1) blow, British, Fawkes, Guy, Parliament, the, to, tried, up 를 모두 사용 (2) 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '폭파하려고 했다'를 'try to + 동사원형'과 이어동사로 영작하는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
주어는 Guy Fawkes예요.

→ '~하려고 했다'는 'try to + 동사원형'이라 과거형 tried to로 써요.

→ '폭파하다'는 이어동사(구동사) blow up이라 blow up으로 붙여요.

→ 목적어 '영국 의회'는 the British Parliament로 마무리해요.

→ 완성: Guy Fawkes tried to blow up the British Parliament
det.tip: try to + 동사원형 = ~하려고 시도하다 / blow up = 폭파하다 (이어동사).

questions.wa: Guy Fawkes tried to blow up the British Parliament
accept: guy fawkes tried to blow up the british parliament
